(2) In a quick cut, she is now wearing the 2nd Anniversary shirt over light blue shorts. She smiles brightly at the camera and holds up a peace sign with her right hand to signify the number two. (3) She holds up another black shirt, this one labeled '3rd Anniversary' with a different set of photos. After a transition, she is wearing it and displays three fingers to the camera while smiling. (4) The sequence continues with the '4th Anniversary' shirt; she puts it on and gestures with four fingers held up, maintaining a cheerful and energetic posture. (5) She presents the '5th Anniversary' shirt, then wears it while holding up an open palm (five fingers) and blowing a kiss to the camera. (6) The '6th Anniversary' shirt is displayed and worn; she makes a 'shaka' or phone sign gesture with her right hand near her ear to indicate six. (7) For the '7th Anniversary' shirt, she wears it and uses both hands to point and gesture, forming a '7' shape or simply indicating the shirt's content with high energy. (8) The '8th Anniversary' shirt follows; she wears it and makes a 'rock on' or 'horns' sign with her hands, looking very happy. (9) She shows the '9th Anniversary' shirt, then wears it while holding up nine fingers across both hands. (10) Finally, she presents the '10th Anniversary' shirt featuring a 3x2 grid of photos; she wears it and holds both hands open toward the camera to signify ten, waving her hands slightly as the video ends.
